blocks.content: Rocks are naturally occurring solid aggregates of minerals that form the Earth's crust. They provide valuable information about the history of the Earth and are fundamental to the study of geomorphology, soil formation, mineral resources, and plate tectonics.
Rocks are naturally occurring solid aggregates of minerals that form the Earth's crust.

items: Core Definition: Remember that rocks are naturally occurring solid aggregates of minerals.
Key Applications: Note the fields fundamental to rock study—geomorphology, soil formation, mineral resources, and plate tectonics.

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: Rocks are naturally occurring solid aggregates of minerals that constitute the Earth's crust.
They preserve valuable historical geological information about the Earth.
Studying rocks is essential to geomorphology and understanding soil formation processes.
Rocks play a vital role in identifying mineral resources and understanding plate tectonics.
